title: Chapter 325
text:
"Can I go now?" Kerlodd asked.

He had promised that he could leave as soon as he arrived at Juberly Hub, so there was no need for him to go back on his words. Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he had a new idea. Kerlodd was an investigator who had logged onto Blue Star before, and he was also a Blue Star citizen. Maybe he could tell him about the Mutation Disaster.

"There's something I want to tell you. I hope you can write it in your report."

"I'll say this first. I'm a professional investigator. I won't write false information." Kerlodd was confused.

You're the only one who's professional? If that's the case, pigs can jump into the ditch!

Han Xiao was speechless for a while before he put on a serious expression and said, "Blue Star is shrouded in a shadow. I have a feeling that a disaster from space will sweep across that poor planet. I hope you can emphasize this to the investigation department. If you still want to send investigators to Blue Star, I suggest that they look for clues carefully. They should be able to find some clues."

Kerlodd did not seem to care. "I'll write it in my report."

Han Xiao was not sure if the Mutation Disaster had arrived yet. If the source of the Mutation Disaster was so easy to find, it would not have been a disaster in the previous version. The chances of Godora taking his suggestion seriously were too low. However, Han Xiao's intention was not to let Godora find any clues. He was just taking precautions.

When the Mutation Disaster really happened on Blue Star, Godora would remember this report, and he would be able to get in touch with Godora. Kerlodd was a potential communication medium.

"Alright, you can go now. We'll meet again," Han Xiao suddenly said. "Remember to take a step with your left leg first."

“？？”

Kerlodd was confused. He waved his hand and said goodbye. After thinking for a while, he walked away with his right leg.

Han Xiao smiled and said, "Hehe, so obedient."

After teasing Kerlodd, it was time to get down to business.

There were many opportunities in Juberly Hub, and Han Xiao had an impression of many of them. However, the most important thing now was to rent a lounge and store the supply boxes. He would be staying in Juberly Hub for a while, so he had to rent a stronghold so that the players wouldn't know where to gather. Also, the lounge could be tied to the log-in and log-off points.

The lounge was located in the central white Tong Tian Tower. Han Xiao and the others boarded a small public aircraft and flew for a while before arriving at the destination.

This type of aircraft was a means of transportation, and it was very easy to control. It was shaped like a small flying saucer, and the four holes at the bottom were anti-gravity devices, shining with a faint blue light. Han Xiao was used to it, but to the players, it was a new experience. Everyone became curious, looking left and right.

The third floor of Skysplit Tower was the Hub's official office. Many people were lining up, and Han Xiao was no exception. He followed the line in boredom.

After queuing for half an hour, he suddenly saw a group of people walk past the line and through the VIP channel. The Hub's staff came out to greet them respectfully.

This group of people were all wearing the same simple pure white combat suit. It was mechanical and looked like simple armor. There was an inverted triangle crystal in the center of the chest. It was of different colors, red, orange, yellow, green, and purple. Long thin pipes extended from the three points. The top two lines went over the shoulders, and the bottom line went over the crotch. The three lines converged into a point on the back, which corresponded to the triangle, which was the center of the back.

"Why aren't they queuing?" Maple Moon asked curiously.

Han Xiao recalled the pattern and slowly said, "Those people are also called the Sky Ring Army. They have tens of thousands of members, and they are a combat organization from the Gelock Star Cluster. They don't belong to any civilization and are like freelance mercenaries. They are famous in the entire Shattered Star Ring. They accept bodyguard, combat, exploration, colonization, and so on. They even accept war employment. They are famous and have special privileges, so they don't have to queue like us. "

The Gelock Star Cluster and the Colton Star Cluster were both located in the Shattered Star Ring and were neighbors. The Sky Ring members who had just passed by had probably accepted the mission in the Colton Star Cluster. From this, it could be seen that Sky Ring's business was very large, and they could accept missions from other Star Clusters.

Sky Ring was too famous, and the members of the organization enjoyed special privileges all over the Shattered Star Ring. Fame in the universe was a very important factor. Just like now, the people of Sky Ring could easily walk through the VIP channel, while a large group of ordinary, nameless travelers had to line up bitterly.

Han Xiao could not help but recall that he also had special privileges in Blue Star. Now that he was in the galaxy, he had to start all over again. Even so, Han Xiao did not miss the benefits of being in Blue Star. Staying in a remote village and being a chicken head would be like staying in the same place forever. Han Xiao had an adventurous spirit in his bones.

After queuing for a long time, it was finally his turn. There were many types of resting rooms. Han Xiao had enough money and rented a medium-sized resting room with a warehouse. The space was large enough to accommodate dozens of people, and the cost was only 40 Enas per month.

The resting room was located in a nearby building. Han Xiao quickly found the door of the resting room according to the door number. He used his authority to open the door, and the heavy metal door slid open, revealing the entire interior. It was simple in style, and the space was large enough.

Everyone filed in, and the players piled the resource boxes into the warehouse. Han Xiao coughed and made everyone look at him. He then said, "We will be staying in Juberly Hub for a while. This will be our stronghold. This is the first time everyone has left the planet, so get used to it in a few days."

No one had any objections. They were still in a state of ignorance, so they followed his orders.

"Why are you so familiar with it?" Maple Moon asked curiously. "Isn't this your first time leaving the planet?"

Han Xiao's deeds in the Blue Star had left the players with the impression that he was a native of the Blue Star, but ever since he entered the galaxy, he seemed to be very familiar with it. Most of the players did not notice, but only Maple Moon noticed this detail.

Han Xiao thought for a while and said coldly, "As you know, my eyes can see the future. Although this is my first time in the galaxy, I can see many things that are far away. More importantly …" Han Xiao took out his communicator and waved it. "I have this."

Maple Moon suddenly felt that she had asked a stupid question. She pouted, and her face was gloomy.

Han Xiao took out a book of the rules of Juberly Hub, placed it on the table, and said, "You guys take a look at these rules first. Don't break the rules and get caught by the guards. I have something to do. You guys stay here and don't move."

Juberly Hub had guards to maintain law and order. Crimes were not allowed, and those who broke the rules would be caught. The players all gathered to read the rules.

Han Xiao left the lounge alone and headed to the market. He had some extra money on hand, so he wanted to buy a class advancement knowledge first.

The market was divided into individual private rooms with control panels. Han Xiao entered a room and opened the trading list. Countless items appeared, including name, introduction, price, seller, and delivery time. It was very similar to online shopping.

The function of the regional online market was to unify all the items in the galaxy. The sellers were waiting for people to buy, and the large number of items made it easier for the buyers to filter. The items were all notarized and inspected, so there was no way one could buy fake goods here.

Han Xiao directly chose the Mechanic class Super knowledge. There were not many sellers selling knowledge in the Colton Star Cluster, and there was no complete set of knowledge. There were a total of fifteen types of advanced knowledge in the three branches, and only eight of them were for sale. Key knowledge like this could even be sold for 50,000 Enas.

Knowledge was extremely expensive, and there was no need for the large organizations to leak it. If they did not want to build relationships with the factions, they could only buy it at a high price.

This was not a problem for Han Xiao. As long as he made many copies of the advanced knowledge and sold it to the players, he could easily earn back his cost. In order to make the players buy his advanced knowledge obediently, he only needed to set the price slightly lower. Not only would it increase the favorability of the players toward him, but it would also generate considerable profits, forming a virtuous cycle.

Unfortunately, this was an ideal situation. The limiting condition was the spending power of the market, and the players were this market. Only a portion of them had 1,500 Enas in their pockets, so this idea could only be temporarily shelved. Although he was short on money, Han Xiao would not sell Class Knowledges cheaply. Letting the players obtain them so easily was not in line with his business philosophy.

Therefore, not only did he have to become rich, but he also had to make the players become rich. The rich first would drive the rest to become rich and build a well-off society.

After searching for a while, he could only afford a borderline advanced knowledge, priced at 11,000 Enas. As the name suggested, this advanced knowledge was mainly about detection and reconnaissance. It was a supplementary knowledge for spectra, radiation, wave bands, and so on.

"It's better than nothing." Han Xiao had no choice. He confirmed the purchase and connected with his personal communicator. The screen showed that the information was being transmitted, and the number in his account started to roll. In the blink of an eye, only 2,000 Enas were left.

Han Xiao's eyes were filled with tears.

It's back!

Everything is back!

This is the feeling! The excitement of playing the Mechanic class in my previous life!

Every time I spend money, my blood pressure will rise to the maximum!

Poverty makes me happy …
